description: Current inventory of top-level files and directories directly under astrid/. This is a documentation artifact, not a runtime input.

classification_categories.public_facade: Part of the public SDK contract.

top_level_files.name: __main__.py
top_level_files.notes: Executable package gateway; delegates to astrid.core.gateway.main().

top_level_directories.name: core
top_level_directories.notes: Framework kernel, gateway, contracts, audit, domains, orchestration helpers, verification, utilities, and shared runtime libraries.

top_level_directories.name: packs
top_level_directories.notes: Pack data only. Top-level Python modules are rejected except __init__.py.

top_level_directories.name: skills
top_level_directories.notes: Agent skill discovery, registry, and harness runtimes.

structure_constants_reference.rule: No top-level implementation modules or compatibility shim files are allowed. New implementation code belongs under astrid/core/ unless it is pack data, SDK surface, package docs, or agent skill machinery.

pack_machinery_layout.rule: New pack machinery belongs in astrid/core/pack/*. astrid/packs/ is for pack data only.
